verdict_text: YES. The script loads the base and adapter, reads scale as alpha over r (2) and `fan_in_fan_out` from the config, computes `B @ A` in float32 (the adapter tensors are float32) and adds `scale * delta` to the base weight promoted to float32, then casts back to the base dtype (float16), for each of the 16 `attention.query_key_value` modules, matching clause 1. No adapter or intermediate tensor is written to `sd`, so clauses 2 and 3 hold, and all four required checks are enforced with `assert` before writing. Sharding is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors` with the 536,870,912-byte limit, which is the same helper used for the baseline and is assumed to write the shards plus `model.safetensors.index.json` as required.
